dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Do you yearn for a life-changing adventure? Do you dream of a journey to cleanse your very soul?"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "If you're finding your quotidian life tedious, come to Yilong Wharf and enjoy our stunning waterfalls and heavenly scenery..."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Er, I'm not sure if I'm misunderstanding this. Are they... inviting Fontainians to look at waterfalls?"
